Ever notice you start sounding like the people around you?

Kevin Trudeau tells how a childhood friend from Boston went to college in South Carolina. Two years later he came home for Christmas with a sudden southern drawl.

Kevin explains that whoever you spend time with, you pick up their expressions, their speech and the way they think and act. That includes their habits, good or bad.

Who has rubbed off on you the most?

#ad #habits #success #kevintrudeau

Why holding a wish loosely beats gripping it tight.

Kevin Trudeau explains that after you feel as if you already have what you want, you release your attachment to the outcome. In other words, it's okay if it never happens.

He calls this counterintuitive. Fear or a feeling of lack can creep in, and that feeling creates more lack. That is why people say it happens when you least expect it.

Where in your life could you hold on a little looser?

#ad #mindset #goals #kevintrudeau

Why do kids smash the sand castle and start again?

Kevin Trudeau says success is a journey, not a destination, and the journey is the reward. It is the act of creating that gives us happiness.

His example is a child at the beach. He doesn't say he wants to have a sand castle, he says he wants to build one. Once it is built, the pleasure is done.

It is about building it, not having it.

What do you enjoy building?

#ad #happiness #success #kevintrudeau
